Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Constitution of Prevention and Prohibition of Ragging CONSTITUTION OF PREVENTION AND PROHIBITION OF RAGGING Anti-Ragging Committee In pursuance of the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India dated 08.05.2009 in Civil Appeal No. 887/2009, the University Grants Commission has framed “UGC Regulations on curbing the menace of ragging in higher educational institutions, 2009” which have been notified on 4th July, 2009 in the Gazette of India. Ragging is a form of abuse on newcomers to any institution and these regulations are intended to check the menace of ragging. STRICT ENFORCEMENT Legal measures & disciplinary actions Ragging is a criminal offense. Ragging is strictly prohibited by both State Govt. and Central Govt. Punishment for ragging will be as follows: 01 Cancellation of admission. 02 Suspension from attending classes. 03 Withholding or withdrawing scholarship, fellowship and other benefits. 04 Debarring from appearing in any test, examination, placement activity, or other evaluation process. 05 Withholding results. 06 Debarring from representing the institution in any regional, national, or international meet, tournament, youth festival, etc. 07 Suspension or expulsion from the Hall of Residence. 08 Rustication from the University. 09 Expulsion from the institution and consequent debarring from admission to any other institution. 10 Fine will be imposed as per severity of an offense. 11 Collective punishment: when the persons committing or abetting the crime of ragging are not identified, the institution will resort to collective punishment as a deterrent to ensure community pressure on the potential offenders. COMMITTEE OBJECTIVES Objectives Objective 01 To aware the students of dehumanizing effect of ragging inherent in its perversity. Objective 02 To keep a continuous watch and vigil over ragging so as to prevent its occurrence and recurrence. Objective 03 To promptly and stringently deal with the incidents of ragging brought to our notice. Objective 04 To generate an atmosphere of discipline by sending a clear message that no act of ragging shall be tolerated and any act of ragging shall not go unnoticed and unpunished. SUPPORT & REPORTING Regulations UGC Regulation 2009 Anti-Ragging Regulations UGC Regulation on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, 2009 completely forbids ragging of any kind in an institute of higher education. National Helpline (24x7 Toll free) 1800-180-5522 Email Support help.antiragging@kpgu.ac.in UGC Website Portal COMMITTEE WORK Functions of the Ragging Committee To design strategies and action plans for curbing the menace of ragging on the university campus. To plan awareness campaigns about moral and ethical principles, human rights, dignity, and gender. To investigate the complaints that students have made about ragging and to investigate this matter. To formulate strategies to prevent and discourage the menace of ragging on and off the campus.
